# Jarvis

> Jarvis is a free AI assistant at https://jarvis-x-ai-two.vercel.app. It chats, helps with homework and code, builds simple websites you can open straight away, finds live news and weather with real sources, reads files and photos, and talks back in a British voice. It asks before acting and never makes up live data or sources.

Made by BobPlayz (Origin Productions) as a school project. Answers come from open AI models through Ollama. You can try it without an account ("Just try it, no email needed") or sign in with an emailed code. No password.

## What it does

- Chat and homework help in English, Telugu, Hindi and more, including Indian cultural topics (muggulu/kolam, Sankranti, Bathukamma and others).
- Website builder: ask for a simple website, answer a couple of quick questions, and Jarvis builds it with a live preview and an Open button.
- Live news, weather and cricket with a "Sources" list showing where each fact came from and when it was fetched.
- Reads PDFs, text files and photos you upload.
- Voice: speak to it, hear replies, and talk back and forth hands-free (you can interrupt it).
- Pictures with answers: real photos for "ideas" questions and simple drawings for explanations.
- Asks before acting: tools that do something for you wait for your approval.
- Remembers only when told ("remember that…").
- Installable as an app on phones and computers.

Generated content can be wrong. Check important answers.
